release.stamp.description: stamp VX_RELEASE_VERSION into package.json, the manifest the binary inlines

release.npm.description: make sure npm can publish with provenance (>= 11.5.1, sigstore intact)

release.prove.linux.description: the linux binaries launch (re-signed only if macOS refuses) and report VX_RELEASE_VERSION

release.assemble.linux.description: assemble the linux npm packages under dist/npm (scripts/build-npm.ts)

release.publish.linux.description: npm publish the linux packages under dist/npm, skipping any already on the registry

release.prove.darwin.description: the darwin binaries launch (re-signed only if macOS refuses) and report VX_RELEASE_VERSION

release.assemble.darwin.description: assemble the darwin npm packages under dist/npm (scripts/build-npm.ts)

release.publish.darwin.description: npm publish the darwin packages under dist/npm, skipping any already on the registry

release.served.description: wait until npm serves every published tarball (HTTP 200), up to 10 min

release.upload.linux.description: attach the linux binaries to the draft release (scripts/release-assets.ts)

release.upload.darwin.description: attach the darwin binaries to the draft release, then publish it (scripts/release-assets.ts)

release.auto.description: tag a green main commit with its next version, release it, dispatch the publish

release.sync.description: give each GitHub release the body of its release post on the site

check.bun.description: refuse a Bun below the floor (engines.bun) before any shard starts

build.description: nothing to build — core is consumed as source; the release binaries are build.bun

source.description: the source dependants import: a key, not a build

check.sandbox-canary.description: drive 20 leaky sandboxed runs through run() under this machine’s sandbox; one it did not enforce fails

check.build-cold.description: every package’s build under this machine’s sandbox, no cache, as a developer runs it

check.binary.description: compile the host binary the way release.yml does; it must launch and report the manifest version

check.binary.linux-arm64.description: compile the host binary the way release.yml does; it must launch and report the manifest version

check.binary.darwin-arm64.description: compile the host binary the way release.yml does; it must launch and report the manifest version

test.platform.description: bun test — only the files whose outcome is the platform’s (the macOS run)

build.bun.description: compile standalone binaries for every target
